reasoning: This is an abstract UI state toggle (disable resize/expand or block pop-out) rather than a concrete object or common human action. At to-do list size, the crossed-out arrow and dashed corner lines are visually noisy and hard to interpret, and almost no real-world tasks have 'un-expand' as their subject.
